items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: So I threw out here with Faith Martin and then he went to send him to come back.

ctx.x: Mm-hm. back there about three months and he died. He went over with us too. Red Island, you see him over there, we used to play together, yeah. That's when I went to Mexico. I cut him to go to Mexico and he told me when I come back my job would be there for me. So when I come back we went together. I couldn't get him to go nowhere. So I threw out here with Faith Martin and then he went to send him to come back. Then he had a break and go to New York. He's been gone ever since.
Ask him did he know Joe Oliver?
